steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Push|: Before damage is dealt, this character may push the target character away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: I‘m the Juggernaut
steps: |!wild| |*Rush|: After this attack is resolved, if it is during this character's activation, this character may immediately use the Nothing Stops the Juggernaut! superpower without paying the |!power| cost.

superPowers.name: Nothing Stops the Juggernaut!
superPowers.body: This character is pushed |!range_small|. It does not stop its movement if it contacts a Size 3 or smaller interactive terrain feature. Instead, the contacted terrain feature is destroyed, then this character continues being pushed. If this character contacts one or more other characters, one contacted character suffers 1 |!damage|, then this character stops as normal. A character can be damaged by this superpower only once per turn. If this character has the Stagger special condition, it loses it.

superPowers.name: Nice Punch...
superPowers.body: If this character would suffer |!damage|, it may use this superpower. Reduce the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1.

superPowers.name: Helmet
superPowers.body: This character cannot be pushed or advanced by the special effects of enemy |!mystic| attacks or enemy superpowers.

superPowers.name: Unstoppable Momentum
superPowers.body: After this character resolves a move action during its activation, it gains 2 |!power|. The next attack made by this character this activation adds 3 dice to the attack roll. This character can be affected by this superpower only once per turn.
